ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white interior pixels (approx. 90% surface area) contrasted against low-intensity black peripheral pixels (approx. 10% surface area).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels dominate the central and proximal regions of both lobes; low-intensity black pixels form a continuous 5-15 pixel wide band along the trailing edge and distal tips; a single distinctive low-intensity circular focal spot is located at the coordinates approximately 80% horizontal and 40% vertical within the fluke bounding box (right lobe).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration map; irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 3 to 12 pixels in depth along the continuous trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobate structure with convex leading edges tapering to acute distal points; trailing edge exhibits a wide concave sweep toward the central median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation on the outer trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip, deviating from the standard serration frequency.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of small dark pixel clusters (mottling) near the lower leading edge margin, partially visible above the water-spray turbulence.
